name: Sacred Path Feature
summary: Sacred Path Feature Preacher When you use Martyr’s Mercy, the target also gains advantage on its next saving throw against fear. Flagellant When you take damage, gain temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus. Purifier Your flamer and firebomb damage increases by +1 per damage die against daemons, heretics, mutants, and corrupted creatures.
